title: Resizing a regular polygon by central reflections of its pebbles
source_title: Schweitzer Miklós Mathematical Competition 2022: Előzetes megoldások 2022
author_responsibility: Original Hungarian statement and printed solution; see the source caveats and exact source ranges.
material_provenance: Fixed author PDF retained by the corpus. Physical PDF page references.
difficulty_reason: The author translates legal moves into even row additions and signs, proves a determinant/parity reachability criterion by descent, then raises a rotation-derived unimodular matrix to a power to meet that parity constraint while preserving a nonunit dilation.

statement_spans.label: 7. Egy szabályos k-szög, including central-reflection move and the question about a different-sized regular k-gon.

proof_spans.label: Megoldás (kitűző) through the final coprime i choice and square before 8. Includes the lattice obstructions, row operations, Lemma 7.1, A and B_i and the mod-2 power.

dedup.scope: 142659 and 900000008 are sparsity pebble games, and 175427 concerns general pebble motion. Their operations and conclusion differ from central reflections resizing a regular polygon.

readability.basis: Fixed report PDF. Printed selected solution is read directly in the stated physical page range.

source_caveats: The source classifies k=3,4,6 as the impossible cases and every other k≥3 as possible. Retain the author's original geometrical and row-operation formulations.
